purpose: Compare candidate-level parallel search with timing-trial parallel search, and test safe identical-course prefix reuse
methods: two workers in the existing timing-trial pool
startup: Included in each measured worker method; bundles built once per process
prefixScope: 41 plans on the identical course, differing only in their final jump threshold
correctness: Ordered plan/window/verdict hashes for every candidate; complete final-world and event hashes for prefix replay
rawOutput: Local temporary benchmark logs; no personal paths or raw logs tracked
backgroundLoad: Exploratory local development run: browser QA and typecheck overlapped some samples. Not an isolated performance lab.
